about_the_game:
About this game

This is a story-focused 2D action fantasy game in which a female swordsman and a musketeer fight against approaching monsters.

The character illustrations have been carefully designed, and a wide variety of unique characters appear.

This is a sequel, and is planned to consist of 4 chapters in total. Currently, only the prologue and trial version have been released.

Multiple endings are planned for the end.

This game was created using RPG Maker MZ, and the play time is approximately 2-3 hours.

It contains grotesque depictions. Please be careful if you are not comfortable with such content.

Story

The country has been protecting its people from monster, a threat to humans, by using a “magic device” that contains the power of magic to create wards throughout the country.

One day, however, the device is forced to stop working by someone, and the wards covering the country disappear, allowing monster to enter and leave.

During this time, the protagonist Rinka sets off to a foreign country to search for her brother and is reunited with her childhood friend Ryu, who was also visiting the country, but the two are suddenly attacked by monster and lose consciousness.

When they wake up in a strange place, their old friend Alto appears before them.

The two learn that he is responsible for everything that has happened to them, and at the same time, he has given them the “power to bind their lives together,” and they become able to share their injuries, pain, and even their lives with him.

The only way to reactivate the device and break the power that has been placed on them is to kill their former friend, Alto.

The two hesitate to kill their friend, but in order to save their country and break the power, they pursue Alto, but in the process, they gradually come to see the true nature of the “Land of the Righteous”.

Description of gameplay and prohibited activities

■Regarding secondary distribution of the game

Secondary distribution of the game is prohibited.

Unauthorized reproduction and secondary distribution of images, music, and materials in the game is also prohibited.

Copyrights of borrowed materials belong to their respective creators.

The creators are not responsible for any damage or injury caused by this work.

Please note in advance.

■Regarding live commentary

Live commentary is possible without reporting.

Please observe the following rules.

If you violate the rules, you may be asked to delete the post.

〇Prohibited items regarding live commentary〇

●Live commentary and live broadcast of clear bonus●

A clear bonus will be available to those who play the game. Please refrain from live commentary of the clear bonus.

Watching during live broadcasts is also prohibited. Please refrain from watching during live broadcasts, even if the screen is hidden.

※Uploading images and text of the clear bonus to SNS is also prohibited.

●Live commentary while slandering a work●

Live commentary while slandering a work is prohibited even if the intention is not to slander.

●Spoiler expressions in video titles●

You may use still images from the game as thumbnails, but please use ones that do not contain spoilers.

▼Please include the name of the game in the video title.

■Original works are welcome, but please refrain from posting content related to crimes.

■Critical comments are welcome, but will be deleted if they are too severe.

■Please include credits for the work.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains gore, murder, and other grotesque depictions. It also contains discriminatory depictions of imaginary creatures and races.
